propositions: Natural fold operations retire and cite orphan event files without applying their effects, causing repairable damage to become silent loss and ORPHAN_EVENT signal erasure before the next fold.

The fold operation must exclude fsck-identified orphans (un-cited pre-snapshot events anchored to a prior snapshot) from both retirement and source_event_uuids citation, preserving the repair window indefinitely.
Shared is_snapshot_orphan predicate must be extracted and reused between compact_txn and fsck to prevent disagreement on orphan classification and ensure consistent behavior across repair paths.

The repair_or_plan gate must enforce AUTO_RECOVER vs HUMAN_TRIAGE routing for orphans, blocking whole-ticket rebuild when HUMAN_TRIAGE orphans are present (routing parity between --repair and --repair-snapshots).
Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must never fold without their governing snapshot present and foldable, preventing silent burial under a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT.
